_help: Raise minSupported to force everyone below it to update. Versions are major.minor.patch. minOs: Android API level / iOS version your newest store build needs (informational — the store enforces it).
message: A new version of Mindvora is available.
_features_help: Hidden features. A feature shows only when enabled=true AND the user's app version >= minVersion. Release flow: ship the build with the feature code -> raise android.latest (soft prompt) or minSupported (forced) -> set enabled=true.
